title: 保时捷削减车型降本增效，中国市场挑战加剧
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Porsche shares P-911 at GY, remain under pressure as the car maker moves to cut the number of models it produces.
segments.zh: 保时捷股价承压，因公司计划削减车型数量。

segments.en: Porsche's new CEO says the portfolio has become two complex.
segments.zh: 新任CEO表示产品组合过于复杂。

segments.en: We're joined by Bloomberg's Detroit bureau chief, David Welch, and David, I guess they have the Panamera, the Taycan, the Cayman, the Boxster, the 9-11,
segments.zh: 我们有请彭博社底特律分社社长David Welch。David，保时捷有Panamera、Taycan、Cayman、Boxster、911、Macan和Cayenne。

segments.en: the Macon, and the Cayenne. So that's seven by my count.
What are we looking at in the future?
I'm not sure if it's necessarily models. They have a lot of trim levels for each one of those models, which is a lot of manufacturing complexity.
segments.zh: 不只是车型，每款车还有大量配置等级，这增加了制造复杂度。

segments.en: I mean, if you wanted a trim one, do you need all the sports cars that they have given the size of the sports car market?
segments.zh: 考虑到跑车市场规模，他们真的需要所有跑车吗？

segments.en: I mean, they would have to keep the 9-11 because it's the name, it's iconic.
segments.zh: 911必须保留，因为它是标志性车型。

segments.en: But do they trim some of those other smaller sports cars that are expensive toys for people?
segments.zh: 但那些作为昂贵玩具的小跑车是否该削减？

segments.en: Maybe. But I think there's probably a lot of complexity, just trim levels, different options and things.
segments.zh: 可能吧，但我觉得复杂度更多来自配置等级和不同选项。

segments.en: And maybe they start to cut that. But they just don't have enough volume, especially given their global issues.
segments.zh: 也许他们开始削减。但他们的产量不够，尤其考虑到全球问题。

segments.en: It's very difficult and expensive now to export to the US, the China businesses tough.
segments.zh: 现在出口到美国非常困难且昂贵，内地市场也很艰难。

segments.en: The Chinese don't really want foreign automakers having a big presence there.
segments.zh: 内地市场并不真正希望外国汽车制造商在那里有大的存在。

segments.en: If you do, if you're going to play in China and General Motors has realized this, you have to export from China to other countries.
segments.zh: 如果你要在内地市场发展，通用汽车已经意识到，你必须从内地市场出口到其他国家。
